methodologyNote: Measured via page views across tracked network traffic.
metricLabel: market share of tracked page views / usage
aiSummary: In October 2026, Chrome led web browsers in South Africa at 73.98% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Safari ranked second at 10.63%, followed by Samsung Internet at 6.82%.

faqs.question: Which item leads web browsers in South Africa?
faqs.answer: Chrome leads at 73.98% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-market-share/south-africa.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for web browsers in South Africa?
faqs.answer: Chrome (73.98%), Safari (10.63%), Samsung Internet (6.82%) in October 2026.
